sections.title: Objective type questions of two 1-mark parts.

questions.q: Match: (i) cos⁻¹(½ sin(π/3 + sin⁻¹ ½)); (ii) cos⁻¹(−sin 7π/6). [π/3, 2π/3]
questions.answer:
(i) sin⁻¹½ = π/6, so sin(π/3 + π/6) = sin π/2 = 1 ⇒ cos⁻¹(½) = π/3.
(ii) sin 7π/6 = −½ ⇒ −sin 7π/6 = ½ ⇒ cos⁻¹(½) = π/3.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: (a) cos⁻¹(½) + 2 sin⁻¹(½) = ______. (b) If cot⁻¹(3/4) = x, then cos x = ______.
questions.answer:
(a) π/3 + 2(π/6) = 2π/3.
(b) cot x = 3/4 ⇒ adjacent 3, opposite 4, hypotenuse 5 ⇒ cos x = 3/5.

Let sin⁻¹x = θ, so sin θ = x and θ ∈ [−π/2, π/2], where cos θ ≥ 0.
cos θ = √(1 − sin²θ) = √(1 − x²).

or.answer: Let cosec⁻¹x = θ, so cosec θ = x. cot θ = √(cosec²θ − 1) = √(x² − 1) (taking x ≥ 1).

questions.q: Express tan⁻¹[(√(1 + x²) − 1)/x], x ≠ 0, in the simplest form.
questions.answer:
Put x = tan θ: √(1 + tan²θ) = sec θ.
(sec θ − 1)/tan θ = (1 − cos θ)/sin θ = 2 sin²(θ/2)/(2 sin(θ/2) cos(θ/2)) = tan(θ/2).
So the expression = θ/2 = ½ tan⁻¹x.
cot⁻¹√3 = π/6. cos(tan⁻¹x + π/6) = 0 ⇒ tan⁻¹x + π/6 = π/2 ⇒ tan⁻¹x = π/3 ⇒ x = √3.

Let sin θ = √(1 − x). Then cos θ = √(1 − (1 − x)) = √x.
tan θ = √(1 − x)/√x = √((1 − x)/x).

2tan⁻¹(cos x) = tan⁻¹[2 cos x/(1 − cos²x)] = tan⁻¹[2 cos x/sin²x].
So 2 cos x/sin²x = 2/sin x ⇒ cos x = sin x ⇒ x = π/4.
